verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents connecting a Google or Outlook calendar, or setting per-meeting-type rules for automatic capture. The closest items are organization-wide recording policies and manual record/pause controls. Those are adjacent controls, not calendar-driven per-meeting-type auto-capture rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
